subject: website
name: Resupply
summary: Resupply's stablecoin app. No public source was found for this frontend: the project's public repository holds its smart contracts only, so it stays at Level 2. When it opens it reads chain data from a dRPC endpoint and contacts WalletConnect's servers. The liquidity pools page also reads yields from Yearn's Kong API and price data from DefiLlama and Curve. What it reaches after a wallet connects was not checked.

connections.name: RPC endpoint (dRPC: lb.drpc.live)
connections.note: Read without a light client. Polled about once a second from page open.

connections.name: Price APIs (DefiLlama's coins.llama.fi, api.curve.finance)
connections.note: Centralised sources named in the build's code; not requested in the 20-second open this time.

connections.name: Yearn Kong API (kong.yearn.fi)
connections.note: New in this build. The liquidity pools page fetches vault yield data from it. Data only, no code. Not requested at page open.

connections.name: WalletConnect's servers (pulse.walletconnect.org, api.web3modal.org)
connections.note: Contacted when the page opens, before any wallet is connected.
